habitat: Tropical/subtropical evergreen broadleaf forest edges; open woodlands; and cultivated areas
story: Few birds capture the imagination quite like the Oriental Turtle Dove (Anthracoceros albirostris). As a member of the Bucerotidae family, it has carved out a unique niche in Tropical/subtropical evergreen broadleaf forest edges; open woodlands; and cultivated areas. Its conservation status is Least Concern (LC), a classification that drives crucial research and protection efforts. The Oriental Turtle Dove's presence is a vital sign of its ecosystem's health, making its preservation a priority. This poster is a tribute to the Oriental Turtle Dove, celebrating its role in the natural world and inspiring a deeper appreciation for biodiversity.
